reason: Prepare the flight carrier at the cold transfer bench so the cores can be moved onto flight cooling.
expectation: I expect the carrier to be prepared for a cold transfer, though I don't yet know how the cores will be loaded.

alternatives.reason: The first specimen also needs to go aboard, but I want to prepare the cold carrier first.

effect: The carrier is chilled and has space for both complete core liners, so I can load the first core.
reaction: The attention to preserving the surrounding ice is reassuring.
reason: Load the stored source core into the conditioned carrier for flight transfer.
expectation: I expect the source core to enter one cradle while remaining cold and sealed.

alternatives.reason: The membrane also needs to be secured, but I want to load the cores first.

effect: The source core is in the first compartment, leaving the second ready for the band core.
reaction: The orderly cold transfer is reassuring.
reason: Load the articulated-body core into the remaining compartment.
expectation: I expect its complete liner to enter the chilled carrier alongside the source core.

alternatives.reason: The membrane also needs securing, but I want to finish loading the cores first.

effect: Both complete cores are packed separately in the carrier, ready for flight cooling.
reaction: Seeing the folded outline again makes the careful transfer feel meaningful.
reason: Move the packed cores into the refrigerated flight bay to secure their cooling.
expectation: I expect the carrier to be secured to the flight bay's refrigeration without mixing the cores.

alternatives.reason: The membrane also needs to go aboard, but I want to secure the cores' cooling first.

effect: Both cores are secured on active flight cooling; the first membrane specimen remains to be brought aboard.
reaction: The transfer buffer bridging the cooling handoff is a satisfying detail.
reason: Place the first specimen at the flight locker; it is the only offered gameplay action and advances the remaining goal.
expectation: I expect the membrane to be placed at the locker, possibly requiring another step to secure it.

effect: Placing the membrane at the flight locker completed the remaining goal; no separate securing step was required.
reaction: The final placement felt abrupt compared with the carefully described core transfer.

mostWorthwhile.text: Loading the band core was the most meaningful moment: the visible folded outline connected the careful transfer to the discovery.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final membrane placement felt least substantial; it completed the goal without a description of how the specimen was secured.

surprise.text: I expected the membrane might need another securing step, but placement alone completed its goal.

arbitrary.text: The membrane placement had a clear purpose, although completing the goal on placement alone felt a little abrupt. The core-transfer sequence made physical sense.

continue.text: Yes, I would choose to continue to see what the receiving laboratories learn, though this chapter's largely sequential transfer offered few meaningful decisions.
